query.text: 请看着我跑步训练，结束后帮我总结动作表现。
query.text_en: Please watch my running training, and help me summarize my movement performance when it's over.

annotation.text_zh: 折返跑训练完成，倒退时前脚掌着地，做得很好。
annotation.text_en: Shuttle run complete! Landing on your forefeet while backing up was great.
